data.content_ref: inline:The relation proposed is 'integration' (SRC_002's low-pass filter mechanism imported into 004c5856e33e), but the substantive claim collapses the filter's removal-of-noise and removal-of-signal into the same operation without showing any actual dependence: the target never states what mechanism the filter IS in 004c5856e33e (e.g., what panel procedure removes slips), so the 'integration' is an unsubstantiated label over an analogy, not a covering principle linking the artifacts. The refutation clause (accuracy-ceiling loss > reliability-floor gain) restates the trade-off but does not test the integration itself — it tests a balance outcome, leaving the dependence asserted rather than grounded.
